question: Which four of the world's five top GPU producers does Kestrel Memory Works supply memory to, and which one is excluded?

evidence_strength.Orbitine Compute AB: named supplier of record in a long statutory filing (ORB-SCD-2026)
3-document chain, never jointly stated (KMW-2026-009 + NVS-2026-022 + NVS-JOB-4471)
evidence_strength.Halcyon Microsystems: alias in earnings transcript (KMW-CALL-Q3) + joint conference session (GMS-2026-AGENDA)

near_duplicate_names.Nyxvolt Labs: unrelated AI software firm, not the GPU producer
near_duplicate_names.Halcyon Micro: informal alias of Halcyon Microsystems, same company
near_duplicate_names.Kestrel Analytics Group: market research firm, unrelated to Kestrel Memory Works

evidence_resolvability.why: the number of zero-evidence producers equals the number the claim says are excluded
